      Shingle and metal warranties, as published

      How steep is your roof?

      Pick a pitch (rise in inches for every 12 inches of run). The labor warranty on a shingle roof depends on it: that is the published rule.

      Roof pitch

      5-yearlabor warranty on a shingle roof: laminate or designer shingles.
      2-yearlabor warranty on a shingle roof with a 3/12 pitch or less.
      GAF Golden PledgeAvailable. Our FAQ calls it a premier warranty, available exclusively through GAF Master Elite contractors.
      Metal: lifetimeAustin Pro workmanship warranty on labor, plus the manufacturer’s warranty, which varies by brand and typically runs 30 to 50 years.

      GAF Master Elite

      A badge GAF says fewer than 2% of contractors hold

      That is GAF’s own statement about its Master Elite designation; we are repeating it, not measuring it. Austin Pro is a GAF Master Elite contractor, and GAF’s Golden Pledge warranty is available through Master Elite contractors.

      GAF Master Elite · documented GAF projects of ours: 200 (2018–2026)

      Fewer than 2 in every 100 contractors nationwide, GAF says.

      One hundred contractors, drawn as dots. Fewer than two would hold the badge: one dot lit, and the next only half lit.

      Storm damage restoration · free inspection · insurance or not

      After the storm: who does what

      Your claim stays yours. Walk it step by step: drag the claim along the line, or choose a step. Of the 31 storm and insurance jobs in our records, 28 included a roof and 17 covered more than one part of the house.

      One free inspection covers every trade on the house

      Look at your roof with us, free.

      A project manager walks every side of the house: siding, trim, windows, roof and gutters. The inspection and estimate are free. After a storm, a free storm inspection is the reliable way to know: hail damage is often invisible from the ground.
